title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis (remake of the 1996 original; Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog, published by Amazon Game Studios) is beating its pre-order targets, owner Embracer Group says (Q2 report, 11 Nov 2026: 'Wishlists and pre-orders continue to exceed our targets', no numbers; WN Hub 11 Nov); launches 12 Feb 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC; Steam India lists Standard ₹3,799 and Deluxe ₹5,499 (appdetails cc=in, read 06:50 IST 12 Nov). Next game Tomb Raider: Catalyst crosses Northern India, 'largest Tomb Raider game ever made' (Amazon); Amazon's 9 Nov update lists it for 2028 and adds Switch 2 (My Nintendo News, Nintendo Everything 11 Nov); 2028 first signalled by Amazon's games head in July (VGC, Gematsu, PC Gamer).
